title: [proposal] Web render guard: research/provisional sections never render as LIVE/FROZEN (G3)
body:
## Defect (GIE-006 §4, G3)

`product/web_mvp.py` `validate_bundle` (L25-67) does not apply the research/provisional rule that `producers/contract.py` applies (L197-202, `RESEARCH_STATUSES`, `ResearchStatusError`). A hand-built schema-1 bundle with a section in state `LIVE` and `producer.methodology.status = PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH` passes the validator and `web_mvp.build`, and the pre-guard `app.js` showed it under a `LIVE` badge with its values.

**Probe, reproduced here:** `tools/build_web_research_guard_fixture.py` passes this kind of bundle through the unchanged `web_mvp.build`. With the pre-guard `app.js` (blob at `f8af596`, sha256 `7944757a…3dbead9`), the DOM contains `11.11`, `22.22`, `66.66`, `77.77` and every `RESEARCH_PROBE_*` token on home, portfolio, leaderboard, news and company/nvda, in ko-KR and en-US. With the guard, none of them appear.

## Change (render time, in `app.js` only)

- `guardSections(data)` runs once, when `data.json` loads. Any section in `('universe', *SECTIONS)` whose state is `LIVE` or `FROZEN_SNAPSHOT` and that carries a research marker is replaced in the **view** by the existing `NOT_AVAILABLE` presentation: `as_of`, `source` and `data` become null.
- That section then shows a localized reason, the marker path and the marker status, for example `producer.methodology.status: PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH`. Its values never reach the DOM, including the Evidence `<pre>`.
  - ko: "게시 승인이 없는 연구·잠정 결과라 표시하지 않습니다."
  - en: "Withheld: research or provisional output without publication approval."
- The served `data.json` is not rewritten, because the guard works on a copy.
- If the universe is withheld, the companies legend and the global search state no longer show `FROZEN_SNAPSHOT`.
- `locale.js` gains one UI string. `style.css` is unchanged.

### Markers mirrored exactly (no new status values, no new policy)

| Marker | Source (exact SHA) |
|---|---|
| States guarded: `PUBLISHED_STATES = ('LIVE','FROZEN_SNAPSHOT')` | `producers/contract.py` L26 @ f8af596 |
| Status set: `RESEARCH_STATUSES = {PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH, IDEA, RESEARCH, PROVISIONAL, PROVISIONAL_INITIAL_PRIOR}` | `producers/contract.py` L28-30, `contracts/enums.py` L33-43 |
| Sections: `SECTION_NAMES = ('universe', *SECTIONS)` | `producers/contract.py` L23 |
| Rule: published state + `methodology.status` in the set → reject | `producers/contract.py` L197-202 |
| Bundle path: `<section>.producer.methodology.status` | `producers/assembler.py` L31 (`_meta`), L47 (`env['producer']`) |
| `research_state.status` in the same set, anywhere in the section | Persisted-record lifecycle. On #17, `publication/extractors.py` L52-55 and L92-95 copy it verbatim as `methodology_lifecycle`, and `predicate.py` L63 checks it against the same `RESEARCH_STATUSES`. On #30, `leaderboard_producer/infra_boundary.py` L88 and L149 map it to producer `methodology.status` |

**Reviewer decision point:** `producers/contract.py` itself rejects only `methodology.status`. The `research_state.status` check uses the same constant set at the path where the repo already stores the same lifecycle. It can only withhold a section, never display one. If the owner wants a strict contract-only mirror, remove that one branch in `researchMarker`.

### P01 `publication_envelope` (#17)

The envelope is a top-level key. Its `decisions` are keyed by `subject_sha256`, not by section, and always carry `schema1_data_state = NOT_AVAILABLE`. It has no per-section lifecycle field, so the guard does not read it. It also never uses the envelope to display anything: `DISPLAY_RESEARCH` stays inactive.

### `tests/test_web_research_guard.py` pins the mirror

- The `app.js` constants must equal `contract.RESEARCH_STATUSES`, `PUBLISHED_STATES` and `SECTION_NAMES`.
- Every fixture section that carries `methodology.status` must be rejected by `validate_snapshot` (`ResearchStatusError`) if and only if the guard withholds it.
- The fixture exercises all five statuses.

## Not changed

- `product/web_mvp.py`: untouched. It is byte-pinned by #17's protected digest and by `tests/test_web_mvp.py`.
- `producers/*`: untouched.
- No schema-1 state is added. The view only reuses `NOT_AVAILABLE`, and `STATES` is unchanged.
- No grant is created, `DISPLAY_RESEARCH` is not activated, and no Research, Frozen or Live grant exists.
- No score, rank, regime, zone or portfolio value is computed or transformed. The diff has no arithmetic on those fields.
- `DEMO` sections are not guarded, because the contract permits research status in `DEMO`. For the owner: P01-H says research bytes are not relabelled `DEMO`, but enforcing that is not part of this mirror.
- Top-level `companies` (including `market_cap_rank`) is not a section and is not guarded.
- No Track C paths, codex/* branches or owner branches are touched. No Holdout or CAL_VERIFY access.

## Follow-up: validator hardening (separate)

The defense-in-depth fix is to apply the same rule in `web_mvp.validate_bundle`. That changes `product/web_mvp.py`, which is part of #17's protected digest (`tests/test_p01_research_publication.py`, `test_protected_engine_bytes_are_unchanged`, `PROTECTED_DIGEST_PRE_ADOPTION` / `PROTECTED_DIGEST_C28_ADOPTED`, around L436 on #30) and of `tests/test_web_mvp.py` (around L75). So that follow-up needs an additive digest re-pin on #17 and its descendants.

It also needs `tools/build_web_research_guard_fixture.py` to inject the hand-built bundle after the build instead of through `build()`. The browser guard stays useful even then, for a hand-placed `data.json`.

## Other G3-area gaps, not addressed here

- `STALE` is only appended inside the `LIVE` badge, and `style.css` has no `LIVE`/`STALE` rule.
- `FRESH` has no label.
- The loading text in `index.html` is not localized.
- Hard-coded strings remain in `app.js` and `network-bridge.js`.
- Render errors after `hashchange` are uncaught.

## Tests (actually executed locally; Python 3.11.15, Node v22.22.0, Playwright 1.56.1 with Chromium 141.0.7390.37 preinstalled. The workflows pin playwright@1.58.2, which was **NOT_RUN** here)

On this branch (`2b53b27`):

- **Full pytest:** `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -rf` gives **435 passed**. The #9 tip `f8af596` gives 431 passed, so this is 431 + 4 new.
- **Existing web workflow commands, unchanged and against the guarded `app.js`:**
  - `global_language_search_test.js`: 26 checks PASS
  - `web_mvp_browser_test.js`: 10 checks PASS, no errors
  - `global_language_search_browser_test.js`: 8 checks PASS
- **New browser test, `tools/web_research_guard_browser_test.js`:**
  - Fixture mode, ko and en, all routes: 9 checks PASS. In this mode:
    - (a) `LIVE` sections with a research methodology status are withheld: qgv `PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH`, changes `IDEA`, news `PROVISIONAL_INITIAL_PRIOR`.
    - (b) `FROZEN_SNAPSHOT` sections with a research marker are withheld: technical `PROVISIONAL`, and leaderboard rows with `research_state` `PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH`.
    - Withheld sections show no `LIVE`/`FROZEN` badge and no probe value.
    - (c) The valid `LIVE` macro section (`VALIDATED`) and the legacy `FROZEN` universe render.
    - (d) `DEMO` portfolio and `NOT_AVAILABLE` relationships render.
    - A universe variant with status `RESEARCH`, served by route interception, is withheld.
  - With `--baseline-app` set to the pre-guard `app.js`: 11 checks PASS. Every card or pane that is not withheld, and the page outside the cards, is byte-identical to the pre-guard rendering. The same bundle leaks under the pre-guard `app.js`.
  - `--mode legacy` against the default build and the demo build: PASS. Rendering is byte-identical to the pre-guard `app.js` on all routes in ko and en, and nothing is withheld.
  - Negative control: the fixture test run with the pre-guard `app.js` **FAILS** (`ko-KR home leaked 11.11`), as expected.
- **CI wrapper:** `.github/workflows/web-research-guard.yml` (new file) runs the pytest, the fixture build and the browser test in fixture mode. The pre-guard comparison is optional and local only.
- **Actions on PR #34 head `2b53b27`:** `web-research-guard` [run 37109567406](https://github.com/kco994553-star/Investment-System1/actions/runs/37109567406) **success** (playwright@1.58.2). `web-mvp-validation` [run 37109567361](https://github.com/kco994553-star/Investment-System1/actions/runs/37109567361) **success** (full pytest + existing browser tests). Actions on the forward-merged trees: NOT_RUN.

- `tests/test_p01_research_publication.py`: 13 passed, including the protected-digest test, because `web_mvp.py` is unchanged.
- Together with `test_web_research_guard`, `test_web_mvp`, `test_global_language_search` and `test_producer_infrastructure`: 52 passed.
- `build_producer_contract_web_fixture.py` followed by `producer_contract_web_browser_test.js`, run as in `codex-integration-readiness.yml`: 6 checks PASS, no errors.
- `web_research_guard_browser_test.js` fixture mode with baseline: 11 PASS. Legacy mode against #30's default and demo builds: PASS.
- #30 web workflow commands (`global_language_search_test`, `entity_metadata_search_test`, `web_mvp_browser_test`, `global_language_search_browser_test`): PASS.
- Full pytest on the earlier merge of `1e90886`: **1169 passed**. #30's tip collects 1165 tests, so this is 1165 + 4. The only difference between `1e90886` and `2b53b27` is the browser test file.

## States

- `BRANCH_STATE`: `integration/web/research-render-guard-v1` @ `2b53b27` (pushed), base `feature/producer-infrastructure-v1` @ `f8af596`.
- `INTEGRATION_STATE`: forward merges into #17, #19, #29 and #30 are clean. The #30 trial tests listed above PASS locally. Actions on the PR head succeeded (web-research-guard, web-mvp-validation). Actions on the merged trees: NOT_RUN.
- `CANONICAL_STATE`: **CANONICAL NOT_MERGED**.
- Maturity (Web research guard): `DESIGN → SYNTHETIC_VERIFIED`. Test vectors only; `REAL_DATA_VERIFIED` is NOT_RUN.
- `USER_DECISION_REQUIRED`: none for this proposal. Merging into #9 or canonical is the owner's or the user's decision.
